recovery_finding.interpretation: The production moment seed reached criterion-qualified physical roots outside the closed-form basin; failed source-strength steps and the full residual trajectories are retained, so small terminal residuals are not treated as recovery.
recovery_finding.topology_qualification: This closed-form fixture is limited and has no X-point; topology is read from each terminal field rather than inferred from the seed.
